modelClaim.name: Kling 4.0
modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
Kling 4.0 — Video Editing Guide

Kling 4.0 can edit a video you already have: swap a subject, change the season or an outfit, add a person, or do several changes at once, while the actions, cuts and dialogue stay where they were.

To show it clearly, we generated one base clip and edited it in different ways. Every edit starts from that same original clip, one change at a time. All prompts below are the exact ones we used, and every result is a single generation.

How to use this guide

- Generate the base clip (or use your own video).

- When an edit uses a reference, prepare your reference image. A plain grey background helps Kling isolate the subject.

- Load the video and the reference into @Kling_ai  4.0 editing and paste the edit prompt.

originalPrompt: Change the season from late summer to late autumn: orange and red leaves on the trees and on the gravel, cooler softer light. Keep the people, the dog and all actions unchanged.
